search_window.basis: Start is the completed_at value independently read from the immediately preceding verified watch heartbeat. Discovery queries specified October 31, 2026; historical search results were screened by actual source date/event date, and prior findings excluded as duplicates.

coverage_notes: Supplementary high-value recall only; the Food Line production nationwide collector remains authoritative. All four requested miss classes searched: sole/last/full-service grocery loss, storm/damage-canceled emergency distribution, abrupt pantry/food-bank service loss, and official immediate SNAP/WIC assistance interruptions.

Twelve targeted fast web searches returned results without tool errors. No new verified qualifying source was found in the bounded interval; search returns were mostly stale or unrelated, so this is not a comprehensive nationwide absence claim.

Previously captured Community Action Services and Food Bank closure in Provo, Utah, effective November 1, 2026, remains a duplicate from the 06:50 PDT watch; no new distinct documented interruption was identified.

Excluded older sole-grocery loss in Spencer, New York (September 2026); El Paso, Texas storm-damaged food-bank temporary closure (September 2026); Stockton, Alabama distribution cancellation (October 10, 2026); Wyandanch, New York soup kitchen fire (October 20, 2026); and Hayward, California food-pantry closure (August 2026).

Excluded October 2025 SNAP government-shutdown notices incorrectly retrieved for October 2026 queries, non-official EBT status pages, donation drives, event cancellations unrelated to emergency food access, and routine program information.
